trello.name: Fix Android 14 photo upload crash
trello.desc: Owner: Marcus. Deadline: Fixed and verified by Wednesday. Fix the NullPointerException in the media picker callback that occurs when a user backgrounds the app mid-upload. Repro steps: start a photo upload, background the app before it finishes, come back. Acceptance criteria: Marcus lands the fix and Sam confirms the fix on the Android 14 test devices and adds it to the regression run.

trello.name: Build backend sync API for offline notes list
trello.desc: Owner: Elena. Deadline: In review before Elena is out on the 17th and 18th. Build the sync API where the client sends its last-synced timestamp and gets a delta of created, updated, and deleted notes. Requirement: Conflict resolution is last-write-wins for now; no merge UI in this pass.

trello.name: Implement client-side offline mode for notes list
trello.desc: Owner: Marcus. Requirements: Implement local cache in Room, queue writes while offline, and replay them when connectivity comes back. Write the acceptance criteria into the ticket. Acceptance criteria: You can open the app in airplane mode, see your notes, edit them, and everything reconciles when you're back online with no data loss.

trello.name: Migrate CI pipelines to GitHub Actions
trello.desc: Owner: Sam. Requirements: Finish the test and release pipelines, keep the nightly build schedule, and run both GitHub Actions and Jenkins systems in parallel for a week before turning Jenkins off. Acceptance criteria: Priya approved the migration, but Jenkins must be kept alive until the parallel week is clean.

trello.name: Add per-user rate limiting to search endpoint
trello.desc: Owner: Elena. Requirements: Add per-user rate limiting to the search endpoint to prevent degradation from misbehaving scripts. Limit is 100 requests per minute per user. Beyond that, return HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header. Also add a metrics counter so we can see who's hitting the limit.

trello.name: Update GDPR consent screen for EU launch
trello.desc: Owner: Marcus. Deadline: August 20 release (launch blocker). Requirements: Get the new copy from legal and rebuild the privacy policy screen so consent is opt-in with separate toggles for analytics and marketing. Nothing should be pre-checked.

trello.name: Write automated regression tests for payments flow
trello.desc: Owner: Sam. Requirements: Write regression tests for the payments flow covering purchase, restore, cancellation, and the receipt validation path. Acceptance criteria: Goal is to have the tests running in CI as part of the new GitHub Actions pipeline.
